question: Below what share of rated capacity does an EV battery reach the end of its usable life under the USABC standard?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%usabc%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%end of life%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%end-of-life%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%rated capacity%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%80%' ORDER BY page, id
